title: PlanRequest
description: The planned spend (engine-spec §2 PlanRequest). The effective card limit K is max_cards if allow_split else 1. The cash repayment of a card is taken on due date minus payment_lead_days. Not yet supported by engine model 1.0.0 and therefore not accepted (rejected, never ignored): merchant, category, allow_installment, reserve_cash_override, reserve_limit_by_card.

currency.description: Currency of every money field of the document.

min_split_minor.description: Minimum amount on every card that is used (cards may override it).

channel.description: Payment channel label (e.g. pos, online). Eligibility per card is CardOption.channel_ok.
